q: You are two days out on an offshore passage, where the boat is drawn, south of the centre of this high. Where does the wind come from?
why: Round a high in the north air turns clockwise and slightly outwards: on its south side it blows from about ENE.

q: You are delivering a yacht along New South Wales, 100 M offshore, where the boat is drawn, north of this low's centre. Where does the wind come from?
why: Southern hemisphere: air turns clockwise round a low, crossing the isobars inwards — on its north side it blows from about WNW.
